evaluations.question: 对比图(a)和图(b)中各语体的语义域分布，“网络小说”在支配动词和承受动词上的分布差异是否反映了该语体主动句和被动句的使用比例？
evaluations.model_answer:

Yes, it does seem to reflect that. In 图(a), "网络小说" (online novels) has a much higher proportion of "支配动词" (dominating verbs) compared to "承受动词" (bearing verbs) – around 75% / 25%. This suggests a higher usage of active voice (because dominating verbs usually go with subjects performing actions).

Contrast this with 图(b), where "网络小说" has a more even distribution between "支配动词" and "承受动词" – roughly 51% / 49%. This suggests a more balanced use of active and passive voice. An increase in bearing verbs could indeed imply a greater reliance on passive sentences.
